### The Power of Overlooking an Offense
Author: Trevin Wax
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/trevin-wax/the-power-of-overlooking-an-offense/
Passage: Proverbs 19:11
Points:
- Wisdom and insight give believers the patience needed to overlook personal slights.
- Abraham Lincoln’s gracious treatment of Edwin Stanton illustrates the fruit of letting go of humiliation.
- Understanding the painful circumstances behind someone's behavior fosters empathy and mercy.
- Choosing forgiveness over grudges can restore relationships and unlock unexpected blessings.

### Restoring Relationships: Use Your Ears More Than Your Mouth
Author: Rick Warren
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-hope-with-rick-warren/daily-hope-with-rick-warren-march-3-2018.html
Passage: Proverbs 19:11
Points:
- Restoring damaged relationships starts with prioritizing sympathy over immediately offering solutions.
- True patience flows from wisdom, which develops when we listen to other viewpoints.
- Listening attentively communicates that the relationship and the person's feelings genuinely matter.
- Christians reflect Jesus when they patiently bear with the frustrations and weaknesses of others.

### The Lord's Established Purpose
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/lords-established-purpose
Passage: Proverbs 19:21
Points:
- People formulate many intentions, but only the Lord's sovereign purposes ultimately endure.
- Recognizing human finitude reveals why trusting our own limited understanding brings anxiety.
- Divine sovereignty provides true comfort because God is completely good, wise, and holy.
- Believers can find soul rest when unexpected disruptions align their lives with God's will.

### Allow God’s Purpose To Interrupt Your Plans
Author: Christina Patterson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-10-2023.html
Passage: Proverbs 19:21
Points:
- While people carry many ambitious goals, human capacity and control remain limited.
- Unfulfilled or disrupted plans should be seen as divine redirections rather than personal failures.
- Biblical figures like the disciples experienced interrupted plans that led to higher callings.
- Trusting the Lord’s prevailing purposes frees believers from anxiety and brings lasting peace.
